response.overview: Princess Cruises does not maintain a dedicated public "escalation" or executive hotline +1-866-254-7549. To reach customer service or request an escalation +1-866-254-7549, call the main pre-cruise and reservation support line at +1-866-254-7549 (1-800-PRINCESS), or use the Princess Cruises Customer Care Portal. Contact Details & Hours Main Phone Number: +1-866-254-7549 (1-800-PRINCESS) Hours (Pacific Time): Monday – Friday: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM Saturday – Sunday: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM Alternative Methods: Live Chat is available directly on the official website for pre-cruise assistance +1-866-254-7549.Ask for a Supervisor: If the first-line agent cannot resolve your issue +1-866-254-7549, calmly ask to speak with a supervisor or team lead. Submit Documentation Online: If your issue involves itinerary changes, reimbursements +1-866-254-7549, or formal complaints, submit details through the Princess Customer Care Form so it is logged in their system with a paper trail +1-866-254-7549.
